native_mechanisms: A growing sailor-chain hung between fire and wall: every shadow depends on the whole accumulated row, not only the newest knot (whole-state, order-dependent chaining that only ever lengthens and is never broken/invertible).
A mark's own pebble-count (popcount of the data word) sets how far the incense swings, bending the firelight before it lands — i.e. the data's own bit-count chooses the mixing displacement.

Only the print taken from the settled shadow, hardened in the stream and read by its ridges, is kept as the token — a one-way compression of the shadow-reading down to a fist-sized mark, with smoke, pebble-cup and old print discarded.
core_technique: A 6-lane SipHash-style ARX sponge (per-lane add-rotate, fixed cross-lane XOR diffusion, length-padded 48-byte blocks, 3–4 finalization rounds, 384→64 fold), where the only native-derived twist is that each round's rotation amounts are offset by a running popcount accumulator (`cup`) of the input words.
